doc:
Item 11.7: changing galleries, erroneous updates, contamination from false matches and stale identity evidence.

PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN (2026-10-07, wave 2):
  Setup. All 1,754 test tracklets of a cache form a pool. Per draw (seed 0..9): floor(30 percent) of each identity's tracklets are
  held out as evaluation probes V; one random remaining tracklet per identity is the enrolment memory M0 (54
  entries); the other tracklets are a stream S in random order. A policy decides for every stream tracklet whether
  to add it to the memory, and under which identity label. Probe matching removes same-camera memory entries
  (label-free). Rank-1 and mAP are computed on one fixed probe set per draw (probes with a cross-camera same-identity
  tracklet anywhere in enrolment plus stream); a probe whose positives never entered the memory scores as a Rank-1
  miss and AP 0, so policies are comparable and coverage is part of the measure; checkpoints after 0, 25, 50,
  75 and 100 percent of the stream.
  Policies: none (enrolment only, stale evidence), oracle (true identity label), self@t (add under the predicted
  identity when the cross-camera top-1 similarity >= tau; tau from leave-one-identity-out on M0 at false-accept
  target t = 1, 5, 10 percent), self_all (always add under the predicted identity), inject@e (oracle updates whose
  label is replaced by a random other identity with probability e = 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4), and capped variants
  (cap = 4 most recent entries per identity, enrolment entry included in the count) of oracle and self@5.
  Hypotheses and falsification criteria:
   H1 (updates help): oracle minus none final Rank-1, identity-cluster 95 percent CI above 0. FALSIFIED otherwise.
   H2 (self-update helps despite contamination): self@5 minus none final Rank-1 CI above 0. FALSIFIED otherwise; the
      contamination rate of self@5 additions is reported with its CI.
   H3 (erroneous updates harm): inject@0.4 minus oracle final Rank-1 CI below 0. FALSIFIED otherwise.
   H4 (evidence expiry protects): capped self@5 minus uncapped self@5 final Rank-1 CI above 0. FALSIFIED otherwise.
  Intervals: identity-cluster paired bootstrap and sign-flip (p11lib.cluster_paired), per encoder, draws pooled per
  identity; Holm over the four hypotheses per encoder.
Outputs results/w2_gallery_update.json.
usage: python3 -I w2_gallery_update.py

g002.tau_note: tau from leave-one-identity-out on the enrolment memory M0 of each draw

s0.tau_note: tau from leave-one-identity-out on the enrolment memory M0 of each draw

s1.tau_note: tau from leave-one-identity-out on the enrolment memory M0 of each draw
